Domain.description: A domain with requirements, types, predicates and an action

Problem.description: A problem with objects, initial state and goal

Action.description: An action with parameters, precondition and effect

Durative action.description: A durative action with duration, conditions and effects

Derived predicate.description: A derived predicate and the goal that makes it true

Universal quantifier.description: A formula or effect for every value of a variable

Existential quantifier.description: A formula that holds for some value of a variable

Conditional effect.description: An effect that applies only if a condition holds

Functions.description: Numeric fluents, such as a vehicle's fuel

Constraints.description: Trajectory constraints on the states a plan visits

Metric.description: What a good plan minimizes or maximizes

Increase.description: An effect that adds to a numeric fluent

Decrease.description: An effect that subtracts from a numeric fluent

Implication.description: A formula that holds if the condition is false or the consequence holds

Preference.description: A named goal a plan should, but need not, achieve

At start.description: A condition or effect at the start of a durative action

At end.description: A condition or effect at the end of a durative action

Over all.description: A condition that holds while a durative action runs

Timed initial literal.description: A fact in :init that becomes true at a point in time
